message.content:
task: FINAL_E2E_REAL_GIT_NO_MOCKS_v1
corr_id: E2E_FINAL_{{utc_date:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}}
owner: agent
artifacts_dir: /opt/feature-factory/artifacts/E2E_FINAL_REAL/{{corr_id}}
context:
  base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8081
  basic_auth: ops:ops123
  repo_owner: basilivanov
  repo_name: FF-TEST
  expected_pr_pattern: "^https://github.com/basilivanov/FF-TEST/pull/\\d+$"
  env_nosecrets_file: /etc/default/feature-factory-test
  env_secrets_file: /etc/feature-factory/ci-secrets.env
  runtime_user: feature
  runner_wrappers:
    restart: /opt/feature-factory/bin/ff-runner-restart-nosudo
    tick: POST /api/v1/runner/run-once
  required_env:
    - SCM_PROVIDER=github
    - GIT_INTEGRATION_ENABLED=true
    - SCM_PUSH_ENABLED=true
    - GITHUB_OWNER=basilivanov
    - GITHUB_REPO=FF-TEST
    - GIT_BASE_BRANCH=main
    - GITHUB_TOKEN (present, non-empty; redacted в логах)
  ci_required_contexts: [lint, tests, build, smoke]
prechecks:
  - "GET {{base_url}}/health/live == 200"
  - "systemd юниты active: feature-factory-test.service, feature-factory-runner.service (или эквивалентный процесс python -m app.runner под feature)"
  - "В рантайме процесса orch видны ключи из required_env; токен редактируй при логировании"
  - "git remote origin == git@github.com:basilivanov/FF-TEST.git; HEAD branch == main"
  - "Webhook GitHub: последняя redelivery ping → 2xx за последние 5 мин (если доступно)"
plan:
  - name: Restart runner to pick latest code (nosudo)
    run: "{{runner_wrappers.restart}}"
  - name: Create feature (autostart)
    run: |
      curl -fsS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        -H "X-Correlation-Id: {{corr_id}}" \
        -d "{\"title\":\"FINAL E2E {{corr_id}}\",\"autostart\":true}" \
        {{base_url}}/api/v1/orchestrator/features \
        -o {{artifacts_dir}}/10_feature_create.json -D {{artifacts_dir}}/10_feature_create.http
  - name: Poll orchestrator for git_branch/pr_url/commit_sha (<=180s)
    run: |
      FID=$(jq -r '.id' {{artifacts_dir}}/10_feature_create.json)
      for i in $(seq 1 60); do
        curl -fsS {{base_url}}/api/v1/orchestrator/features/$FID \
          -o {{artifacts_dir}}/20_feature_${FID}_snap.json
        jq -r '.pr_url // empty' {{artifacts_dir}}/20_feature_${FID}_snap.json | grep -E '{{expected_pr_pattern}}' && break
        sleep 3
      done
  - name: Validate real PR URL shape
    run: |
      jq -r '.pr_url' {{artifacts_dir}}/20_feature_*_snap.json | tee {{artifacts_dir}}/30_pr_url.txt
      grep -Eq '{{expected_pr_pattern}}' {{artifacts_dir}}/30_pr_url.txt
  - name: Extract pr_number and head_sha for CI statuses
    run: |
      PR_URL=$(cat {{artifacts_dir}}/30_pr_url.txt)
      PR_NUM=${PR_URL##*/}; PR_NUM=${PR_NUM%%[^0-9]*}
      HEAD_SHA=$(jq -r '.commit_sha' {{artifacts_dir}}/20_feature_*_snap.json)
      printf '{"pr":%s,"sha":"%s"}\n' "$PR_NUM" "$HEAD_SHA" | tee {{artifacts_dir}}/31_pr_ci_inputs.json
  - name: Send 4 CI statuses (Basic auth) in correct schema
    run: |
      read PR SHA < <(jq -r '.pr, .sha' {{artifacts_dir}}/31_pr_ci_inputs.json)
      for ctx in lint tests build smoke; do
        curl -fsS -u {{basic_auth}} -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
          -d "{\"pr_number\":$PR,\"head_sha\":\"$SHA\",\"state\":\"success\",\"context\":\"$ctx\",\"description\":\"FINAL E2E {{corr_id}}\",\"target_url\":\"{{base_url}}/health/live\"}" \
          {{base_url}}/api/v1/ci/status | tee -a {{artifacts_dir}}/40_ci_status_responses.jsonl
      done
  - name: Runner tick until merged (<=240s)
    run: |
      FID=$(jq -r '.id' {{artifacts_dir}}/10_feature_create.json)
      for i in $(seq 1 24); do
        curl -fsS -u {{basic_auth}} -XPOST {{base_url}}/api/v1/runner/run-once -o {{artifacts_dir}}/50_runner_once_$i.json
        curl -fsS {{base_url}}/api/v1/orchestrator/features/$FID -o {{artifacts_dir}}/51_feature_${FID}_post_$i.json
        jq -e '.merged == true' {{artifacts_dir}}/51_feature_${FID}_post_$i.json && break
        sleep 5
      done
  - name: Post-merge health & metrics
    run: |
      curl -fsS {{base_url}}/health/live -o {{artifacts_dir}}/60_health_after.txt -D {{artifacts_dir}}/60_health_after.http
      curl -fsS {{base_url}}/api/v1/metrics | tee {{artifacts_dir}}/61_metrics_after.txt
dod:
  - "PR URL: {{expected_pr_pattern}} (из orchestrator.features.{id}.pr_url) — НЕ mock"
  - "После 4×success — merged==true и есть merged_sha в ответе оркестратора"
  - "POST /runner/run-once → ≥3 успешных тика; артефакты 50_*.json присутствуют"
  - "POST /ci/status → 4×HTTP 200; файл 40_ci_status_responses.jsonl содержит all_success=true хотя бы в одном ответе"
  - "Health after merge: /health/live == 200; в метриках: 'db_rw_ok 1' и актуальный 'ui_bundle_hash'"
notes:
  - "Без стабов/моков: проверяем реальный PR/merge против GitHub; токены и secrets уже заданы в SSoT."
  - "Если merge требует protected checks, статусы проставляем этим же шагом."
